svg.aria-label: Sliding-window attention. Left: the causal mask of global attention, a full lower triangle, against the mask of a local layer with a window of four, a band along the diagonal. Middle: through three local layers, a token reaches four, then seven, then ten tokens back, because each layer reads the previous layer's summaries. Right: the rolling buffer, four slots, where token i is written into slot i mod 4 over the token that left the window
svg.title: Sliding-window attention. Left: the causal mask of global attention, a full lower triangle, against the mask of a local layer with a window of four, a band along the diagonal. Middle: through three local layers, a token reaches four, then seven, then ten tokens back, because each layer reads the previous layer's summaries. Right: the rolling buffer, four slots, where token i is written into slot i mod 4 over the token that left the window
svg.text: A window of W = 4: the mask, the reach, the cache
each token sees itself and the three before it; information still travels further
W − 1 more tokens with every layer
the rolling buffer: token i goes into slot i mod 4
token 10 overwrites token 6, which has just left the window
after token 9 the buffer holds tokens 6 to 9, out of order;
the order doesn't matter, positions are already rotated into
the keys, and the cache never grows past W
